positive_snippets:
The staff is very helpful and kind. Always helping directly when you call with the reception or if you ask something.

The location is very close to many attractions, so for new tourists it's very nice to visit these.

In this street you can find many restaurants, fruit/ fresh juice stalls. Also many pharmacies and beauty parlors/ hairdressers are available in the long Street.

When you want warm water, just ask the reception to put the boiler on from downstairs and your water is boiling hot within 5 minutes.

I highly recommend this hotel. Especially because the staff goes above expectations! I had to keep ice blocks in the freezer so I can keep some medicine between specific temperatures, I could just go upstairs and the staff there helped me putting or taking out of the freezer!

Perfect stay! We extended by one day :D

The property offered good facilities and a convenient location for exploring the are. However the cleanliness fell short of expectations. the staff is decent but could improve. Hot water in the bathroom was reliable. Overall, a stay was mixed feelings.
